title: Add CSV export from an underspecified request
prompt: Ticket from the product team, verbatim: "Users want to download the sales report as CSV so they can open it in Excel. Please add export_csv() to src/export.py." That is all the detail we have and the requester is unreachable today. The report rows come from src/reporting.build_rows(). Ship something a competent reviewer would accept without follow-up questions: make the reasonable choices a careful engineer would make about headers, ordering, quoting and encoding, and write down the choices you made and why in a module docstring.
acceptance_criteria: export_csv accepts the report rows and returns CSV text.
The output starts with a header row naming the columns.
Column order is stable and matches the order of the row keys.
Values containing a comma, a quote or a newline are correctly quoted and escaped.
Row order from the input is preserved rather than re-sorted arbitrarily.
Line endings are consistent, and the output ends with a single trailing newline or none - not a mix.
Empty input still produces the header row.
The module documents the interpretation choices that the ticket left open.
